result.summary: Found 1 issue: a visual overlap/clipping on the bottom edge where the next restaurant card is partially shown under the navigation bar or cut off incorrectly.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps or sits directly on top of the list content, but the bottom card is also slightly cut off without proper padding.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding to the scrollable container so content is not obscured or awkwardly cropped by the navigation bar.
